event.description: Replace the value map with a global rank-6 SVD factorization
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 8 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0020, which removed attention output projections and qualified at 3,168 parameters and 99.94%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0101, whose block-diagonal per-head value maps scored 0.00% at 1,593 parameters. Hypothesis: attempt-0101 failed because it removed global cross-half value mixing, whereas the learned value transform may still have low intrinsic rank. This major representational change preserves the reconstructed 32x16 Q/K maps exactly and replaces the global 16x16 value map with its best rank-6 SVD factorization (16x6 and 6x16), yielding 1,657 parameters. It is more informative than a rank-5 candidate because rank 6 is the highest integer rank that produces a strict parameter reduction once full Q/K maps are retained; it therefore tests value-rank compression with minimum representational loss. Generic two-head causal softmax self-attention and autoregressive decoding remain intact.
